newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Abaco reports Q1 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Abaco reports Q1 net loss.

text.p: Mexican financial firm Grupo Financiero Abaco reported Wednesday a net loss of 451.8 million pesos in the first quarter of 1997. It gave no comparison for the same quarter a year earlier.
Banca Confia, the banking unit and main subsidiary, reported a first quarter loss of 445.1 million pesos, Abaco said in a statement. No comparison was given.

"When all new (U.S. GAAP) accounting principles are applied, the final revision of the bank's capitalisation level was 8.6 percent," Abaco said, without detailing a date or reference period for the level in question.
